name: [HUNT] 🎂NEED MORE FRIENDS🎂
desc:
Yay! It's your birthday! You wake up to a lovely morning, you prepare for your birthday with your mom and dad and make sure that everything is in place! As it's time to celebrate and eat your delicious birthday cake, you start to feel sad and lonely because no friends have shown up yet. Your mission is to find different ways to make friends come over and celebrate with you! What should you do to make your birthday the best one ever?!

Thank you everyone for your support, more endings are on the way!😉

Credits to MaxXD_22 for making "NEED MORE HEAT." This game were heavily inspired by it. Go play his game if you haven't yet!

A game developed by Malte & Bailey💥
Tags: Endings, Need More, Friends, Strict
